items.q: One time, when Dave Tough came from Paris and worked Ceriuti's, he said, "Come on, I want you to meet this girl."

ctx.x: Yeah. May Bonds(?)... One time, when Dave Tough came from Paris and worked Ceriuti's, he said, "Come on, I want you to meet this girl." And this is back in 1930...
